title: Fix redirect loop after login when session cookie is stale
body:
## Summary
After a deploy, users with a session cookie from the old signing key hit an infinite redirect between `/login` and `/dashboard`. The middleware treated an invalid signature as "logged in, but expired" and redirected back to login, which then saw the cookie and redirected to the dashboard. We now clear the cookie when the signature is invalid, so the user gets a clean login page.

Closes #482

## Changes
- `src/middleware/auth.ts`: distinguish `InvalidSignature` from `Expired` and clear the cookie on invalid signatures.
- `src/lib/session.ts`: export `SessionError` types used by the middleware.
- `test/auth.middleware.test.ts`: new cases for stale-key cookies.

## Testing
- `npm test -- auth.middleware` (3 new tests, all pass).
- Manually: logged in on staging, rotated `SESSION_KEY`, reloaded `/dashboard` and got the login page once with no loop.

## Risk and rollback
Risk: users with stale cookies are logged out once after deploy (expected). If logins break, revert this PR; no migrations involved.

## Screenshots
Before: browser network tab showing 20+ alternating 302s between /login and /dashboard.
After: a single 302 to /login, then 200.
